outcome: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS) - Medium form
Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS) - Severe form
cohort: A 39-year-old gravid woman with pre-existing hypertension and type II diabetes who gave birth via C-section to fraternal twins (one male, one female) at 28 weeks of gestational age.
finding: Antenatal corticoprophylaxis appears to benefit NRDS incidence and severity, but individual responses can vary significantly, as one twin with a severe form of NRDS required more invasive ventilation and developed a pneumothorax despite similar treatment initiation to the other twin with a medium form.
birth_weight: Twin Y = 1000gr, Twin X = 1050gr (Very Low Birth Weight)
